# StreamDek Mobile v2.0.0

StreamDek Mobile 2 is a native Android release focused on faster browsing, more reliable playback, and a cleaner mobile experience.

Highlights include:

- Native Compose interface and player
- Improved live TV browsing, channel switching, favourites, and source recovery
- Profile-scoped add-ons, preferences, subtitle sources, favourites, history, and playback memory
- Redesigned Settings and add-on management
- Restored signed in-app updates with upgrade compatibility for existing installations
- Stability and performance improvements throughout the app
